items.statement: Each reported SO2-addition transition-state candidate is frequency-validated as a transition state rather than a minimum, and the Int2-a reference is treated as the common reactant state.
items.expected: The submission reports one imaginary mode for each site-specific TS and identifies the common Int2-a reference.

items.statement: The competing TSs are assigned to distinct SO2-addition channels by connectivity validation.
items.expected: The 1,4 candidate is connected to the Int2-a-side 1,4 adduct and the 1,2 candidate to the Int2-a-side 1,2 adduct, with evidence for each assignment.

items.statement: The validated 1,4 SO2-addition pathway from Int2-a has a reported Gibbs free-energy barrier of 3.2 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The submitted 1,4 barrier is approximately 3.2 kcal/mol under the submitted reference convention.

items.statement: The validated 1,2 SO2-addition pathway from Int2-a has a reported Gibbs free-energy barrier of 7.6 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The submitted 1,2 barrier is approximately 7.6 kcal/mol under the submitted reference convention.

items.statement: The 1,4 barrier is lower than the 1,2 barrier by 4.4 kcal/mol, supporting the observed 1,4 selectivity.
items.expected: The submission preserves the ordering 1,4 lower than 1,2 and reports a difference near 4.4 kcal/mol.
